correctness.rationale: For any complex B, Haar phase orthogonality yields off-diagonal squared norm sum_{i!=j}|b_ij|^2/12. Noncollinear normal A determines all three weights. Collinear distinct A has uniform conditional simplex segment [0,L_r(t)], with integrated conditional variance (1/6)int_0^1 L_r^3 dt=1/24 exactly. Repeated spectral blocks average by unitary invariance and the exact n=3 fourth-moment formula. Orthogonal diagonal complement has H_r=1+r^2+(1-r)^2; comparison gives the sharp 3/4 factor, realized at r=1/2; noncollinear perturbation gives genuine discontinuity. The existing verify.py script executed with representative checks, and finite simulation was not used as proof.
